statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I25.10
The denial reason code is CO-197
The patient has recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
There is concern for an arrhythmic etiology underlying the syncopal events
A mobile cardiac telemetry study was ordered to capture transient rhythm disturbances during daily activities
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
The denial constitutes a failure to meet the plan's prior authorization requirements
